Question 14
?

If Y={0,2,4,…,140}, which collection of subsets of Y is a partition of Y?

a
{{0,4,8,…,140},{2,6,10,…,138}}
b
{{0,4,8,…,140},{2,10,18,…,138}}
c
 {{2,4,6,…,140}}
d
{{0,4,8,…,140},{2,4,6,…,138}}
e
 {∅,{0,2,4,…,140}}
